title: Dark-Energy Stress Lab frozen 2027 prediction ledger
amendment_policy: Never replace this record. Publish clarifications or corrections as separately hashed amendments.

predictions.claim: The held-out isotropic distance residual for the final DESI tracer nearest z=0.706 has absolute z below 2.0.
predictions.qualifying_data: Final public DESI BAO release available by the scoring cutoff.

predictions.claim: The held-out Alcock-Paczynski ratio residual for the final DESI tracer nearest z=0.706 has absolute z below 1.5.
predictions.qualifying_data: Final public DESI BAO release available by the scoring cutoff.

predictions.claim: Final DESI BAO plus the baseline CMB combination prefers CPL time variation over constant-w at less than 3.0 sigma after calibration.
predictions.qualifying_data: Final public DESI BAO release and baseline likelihood configuration available by the scoring cutoff.

predictions.claim: No single final-DESI tracer deletion reduces the direct time-variation equivalent significance by 0.75 sigma or more.
predictions.qualifying_data: Final public DESI tracer-level BAO likelihood available by the scoring cutoff.

predictions.claim: A qualifying Rubin-era survey-aware calibration fit has abs(low-z relative magnitude offset) below 0.020 mag and changes abs(Delta chi2) by less than 4.
predictions.qualifying_data: First public Rubin-era supernova cosmology analysis with survey-aware low-z cross-calibration released by the cutoff; otherwise unscored.

predictions.claim: Neither final DESI BAO nor a Rubin-era supernova analysis separately reports a look-elsewhere-aware 5-sigma rejection of constant-w in favor of time variation by the cutoff.
predictions.qualifying_data: Public final DESI or Rubin-era cosmology result by the cutoff.

scoring.unscored: Exclude only when the prediction's qualifying data do not exist by the cutoff.
scoring.conjunction_rule: All thresholds in a conjunctive prediction must pass.
